title: Code Index — Module / Function / 1000-Line Counting Spec
description: Machine-readable companion to docs/CODE_INDEX_SPEC.md. Defines what counts as module, function, line, threshold, exclusions, and supported languages.

module.definition: One source file = one module. Never a package, directory, or build target.

function.definition: Any named callable with a body recognised by the language grammar as a function-like declaration. Anonymous/inline callables are excluded.
inclusions: JS/TS: function declarations, class methods, object-literal methods
Python: def / async def at any nesting level
anonymous function expression bound to a named variable (recoverable binding name)
exclusions: arrow functions / lambdas passed inline as callbacks

lines.span: From opening signature line to matching closing delimiter, inclusive; for modules, whole file.
lines.blank_lines: excluded — empty or whitespace-only lines contribute 0
lines.comments: excluded — line comments (//, #, --, ;) and block comments (/*..*/, """..""", <!--..-->, ///, //!). Docstrings/JSDoc are comments. Trailing comments on code lines do NOT exclude the line.
lines.implementation_hint: Use tree-sitter or language-aware parsing, not regex

threshold.description: Strictly greater than. LOC == 1000 is clean; LOC >= 1001 violates. Never use >=

exclusions.generated_marker: First 5 lines contain DO NOT EDIT / auto-generated / generated by / Code generated / @generated
exclusions.minified_heuristic: Any line > 500 chars and average < 5 lines per 1000 chars => minified
exclusions.note_tests_crate: crates/*/tests/ are product tests: excluded from violation list but may appear in full inventory with kind=test

conformance: Uses effective LOC per lines formula (blank + comment-only removed)
